title: Back
description: Short press: hide HUD, go back, close tab, or go home. Long press to close the current website.

title: Close tab
description: Close the current tab; if it is the last tab, switch websites or go home.

title: LB+A: Drag
description: Hold to drag with the left stick; press A again to release.

title: RB+A: Right-click
description: Open the context menu at the cursor.

title: LB+D-pad: Zoom and font size
description: Zoom the page with up/down; adjust minimum font size with left/right.

title: LT+D-pad: Back / forward
description: Left to go back; right to go forward.

title: LT/RT+stick: Precision / speed
description: Hold LT for slower movement or scrolling; hold RT to move faster.
